a: What a runner works on in practice, and what good habits take over time
A long car for prom night
d: A toy with a face and a dress
A line of seats in a theater
n: Form is what practice does over time. The first week with an AI tool feels clumsy, the way a new swing or a new stride does. Then the small habits settle in: you say what you want, you give it what it needs, you check the work before it leaves your hands. Nobody starts with good form. It comes from doing the same simple things on ordinary days.
